mentor.text: Clicks fell from 107 to 78 while Google showed us slightly more often: we are seen but not clicked. Most searches sit on page 2 (positions 11–20). Rewrite the titles and descriptions of the 5 pages with most impressions, starting with the home sauna page.
“Home sauna uk” (3,600 searches a month) and “sauna in london” (6,600) just entered the top 20. These are the biggest prizes: link to the matching service page from every new blog post this week.

Clicks rose from 34 to 46, but only 3 in 1,000 people who see the site click it. “Indoor swimming pool builders” (1,300 a month) is now at position 15 and the basement pool searches at 13–15: a dedicated basement/indoor pool page with photos and a quote button is the quickest win.
